chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
If you find a louse while you are praying, bury it among the pebbles.
ai.seo_question: What should one do if a louse is found on the body during prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi illustrates the Shia juristic principle of minimizing distraction (khushu') during prayer by avoiding the vigorous motion of killing small insects. By burying the louse in pebbles, the worshipper prevents the potential impurity (najāsah) of its blood or body from spreading, thereby preserving the validity of the prayer without the need for extensive movement or wiping.
